queries.name: sql_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS db_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS user_name;

queries.name: commercial_required_object_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id LEFT JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND o.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad','Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2','vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime','Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto','Sync_Sales','Scheduler_BitacoraJobs') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id;
